subject: english
stem: The speakers are talking during a short break. What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: an invitation to a show at the gym on Thursday
a request to move the show from the gym
a question about tickets for the gym
an invitation to the Tuesday school show at the gym

optionRationales.reason: an invitation to a show at the gym on Thursday：此項把「the Tuesday school show at the gym」改成「a show at the gym on Thursday」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Tuesday school show at the gym」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Tuesday school show at the gym」。

a request to move the show from the gym：此項把「an invitation to the Tuesday school show at」改成「a request to move the show from」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Tuesday school show at the gym」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Tuesday school show at the gym」。

a question about tickets for the gym：此項把「an invitation to the Tuesday school show at」改成「a question about tickets for」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Tuesday school show at the gym」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Tuesday school show at the gym」。
an invitation to the Tuesday school show at the gym：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Tuesday school show at the gym」。
